build_FairseqTask_setup_task: build a FairseqTask instance by calling setup_task with parsed argparse arguments
create_FairseqTask_load_dataset: create a dataset split by calling load_dataset with a split name like train or valid
run_FairseqTask_get_batch_iterator: run a batched data iterator over a dataset with configurable max tokens and sharding
build_FairseqTask_build_model: build a model instance for this task by calling build_model with argparse arguments
run_FairseqTask_get_loss: run loss computation by calling get_loss with a model, criterion, and sample batch
